dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where isnotempty(ioc) and coalesce(tobool(is_whitelisted), false) == false
| extend IocType = tolower(tostring(ioc_type))
| extend ObservableKey = case(
    IocType == 'ipv4', 'ipv4-addr:value',
    IocType == 'ipv6', 'ipv6-addr:value',
    IocType == 'domain', 'domain-name:value',
    IocType == 'url', 'url:value',
    IocType == 'email', 'email-addr:value',
    IocType == 'filehash-md5', 'file:hashes.MD5',
    IocType == 'filehash-sha1', "file:hashes.'SHA-1'",
    IocType == 'filehash-sha256', "file:hashes.'SHA-256'",
    '')
| where isnotempty(ObservableKey)
| extend RawValue = trim(@"\s+", tostring(ioc))
| extend ObservableValue = iff(IocType == 'url', RawValue, tolower(RawValue))
| extend FirstSeen = unixtime_seconds_todatetime(tolong(first_seen))
| extend LastSeen = unixtime_seconds_todatetime(tolong(last_seen))
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| extend ValidFrom = coalesce(FirstSeen, now())
| extend Modified = coalesce(LastSeen, now())
| extend ValidUntil = datetime_add('day', 30, coalesce(LastSeen, now()))
| extend Created = ValidFrom
| extend RiskScore = toint(risk_score)
| extend Confidence = iff(isnull(RiskScore), 50, iff(RiskScore < 0, 0, iff(RiskScore > 100, 100, RiskScore)))
| extend Labels = iff(isnull(behaviour_tags), dynamic([]), behaviour_tags)
| extend Malware = iff(isnull(related_malware), dynamic([]), related_malware)
| extend ThreatActors = iff(isnull(related_threat_actors), dynamic([]), related_threat_actors)
| extend patternValue = replace(@"'", @"\\'", replace(@"\\", @"\\\\", ObservableValue))
| extend Pattern = strcat("[", ObservableKey, " = '", patternValue, "']")
| extend idHex = substring(tostring(hash_sha256(strcat('CybleVision|', ObservableKey, '|', ObservableValue))), 0, 32)
| extend Id = strcat('indicator--', substring(idHex, 0, 8), '-', substring(idHex, 8, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 12, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 16, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 20, 12))
| extend SourceSystem = 'CybleVision'
| extend LastUpdateMethod = 'Cyble Vision IOC CCF'
| extend IsActive = true, IsDeleted = false, Revoked = false
| extend AdditionalFields = pack('iocType', tostring(ioc_type), 'riskScore', RiskScore, 'confidenceRating', tostring(confidence_rating), 'sources', sources, 'behaviourTags', Labels, 'targetCountries', target_countries, 'targetRegions', target_regions, 'targetIndustries', target_industries, 'relatedMalware', Malware, 'relatedThreatActors', ThreatActors, 'firstSeen', FirstSeen, 'lastSeen', LastSeen)
| extend Data = pack('type', 'indicator', 'spec_version', '2.1', 'id', Id, 'created', Created, 'modified', Modified, 'name', ObservableValue, 'description', strcat('Cyble Vision IOC (', tostring(ioc_type), '), risk score ', tostring(RiskScore), ', confidence ', tostring(confidence_rating), iff(array_length(Malware) > 0, strcat(', malware: ', strcat_array(Malware, ', ')), ''), iff(array_length(ThreatActors) > 0, strcat(', threat actors: ', strcat_array(ThreatActors, ', ')), '')),'indicator_types', pack_array('malicious-activity'), 'pattern', Pattern, 'pattern_type', 'stix', 'valid_from', ValidFrom, 'valid_until', ValidUntil, 'confidence', Confidence, 'labels', Labels)
| project TimeGenerated, Id, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, SourceSystem, Confidence, IsActive, IsDeleted, Revoked, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Created, Modified, LastUpdateMethod, AdditionalFields, Data
